why: Fixed viewpoints the benchmark pins the headset's camera to (bench.py), and the offline harness renders (offline_frame::render_the_bench_views), so the frame measured on the device can be looked at on the development machine. World metres; eye height 1.6 m. Names are letters, digits, '_' and '-'.

views.name: torch_pillar
views.note: The player's flashlight (right stick click) held at the hip, aimed at the marble pillar from 3.4 m: its pool on the pillar, the pillar's shadow on the floor and wall behind, its highlight on the polished stone and in the floor's reflection. Compare with `pillar`, the same view without it.

views.name: torch_floor
views.note: The flashlight aimed down at the polished marble ahead: its hot spot, its sharp highlight in the floor and the beam's edge across the stone.

views.name: torch_hallway

views.name: torch_in_hand

views.name: torch_facing

views.name: torch_floor_mirror

views.name: torch_pillar_mirror
